title: TIC file library manifest
description: Describes the documents served at /forms (also the redirect target for the legacy /file-access and /file paths). Grouped by insurer on the page, which makes /forms the one route on this site that names insurers in public copy — everywhere else `npm run verify:copy` fails the build on one. The authority is lib/forms-schema.ts, which validates this file at build time and throws on a mismatch; this copy exists so an editor can autocomplete and lint while typing.

title.description: The document's own name. Must NOT repeat the insurer — the group heading directly above it already says that.

file.description: Path relative to /public, e.g. /forms/files/claim-form.pdf. The build throws if it does not exist on disk.

carrier.description: The insurer, as a member would recognise it. This is the grouping key and it is rendered.

category.description: The row label: Claim form, Enrolment, Guide, Policy document.

productLine.description: e.g. 'International Health, Outpatient Plan'. Shown beside the category.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or GLOBAL. Filing only; not rendered today.

updatedAt.description: The DOCUMENT'S own revision date, not the day it was added here. Leave it out rather than guess — a wrong date tells a member their claim form is current when it may not be.
